Title: TC-01.1 [AC-01.1] Category lists exactly the 5 values

Step Action: As admin, open Copilot Service workspace and select New Case.
Step Expected: The case form opens with a required Category field.
Exactly 5 values: Facility Rental, Registration Issue, Refund Request, Complaint, Asset Maintenance (plus the empty --Select-- entry).

Title: TC-01.2 [AC-01.2] Case without Category is not saved

Step Action: New Case: enter Case Title and Customer; leave Category empty.

Step Expected: The case is not saved; Category is flagged as required.

Title: TC-01.3 [AC-01.3] Invalid Category value is rejected through the Web API

Step Action: Precondition check: Needs a Web API client that can send POST requests.
With a Web API client signed in as admin, POST a case with lkv_category set to an integer that isn't one of the 5 option values.
Step Expected: The request fails with an error; no case is created.

Title: TC-01.4 [AC-01.4] Front Desk can change Category; minimal user can't

Step Action: Sign in as Front Desk test user (user1). Open an existing test case, change Category, Save.
Step Expected: Saved; the new Category is shown.

Step Action: Sign in as minimal test user (user3, Basic User only). Try to open the same case.
Step Expected: The case can't be opened or edited (no access).

Title: TC-01.5 [AC-01.5] Category change is recorded in audit history

Step Action: Precondition check: Auditing enabled for the environment, Case table and Category column.
As admin, change the Category of a test case and Save.

Step Expected: An entry shows old value, new value, the user and the time.
